prompt: Build the state produced by: (1) the standard p=1 QAOA circuit for MaxCut on the 4-node cycle graph as in the qaoa_maxcut_4q task (edges (0,1), (1,2), (2,3), (3,0), gamma = 0.6, beta = 0.4: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, cost layer CNOT(i,j)-RZ(2*gamma,j)-CNOT(i,j) per edge in that order, mixer layer RX(2*beta) on every qubit), followed by (2) an additional RZ(pi/4) gate applied to qubit 0. Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
